subject: ScaleRunner uplift — quarterly bucket top-up and legal timing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@cloudwave.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: ScaleRunner uplift — quarterly bucket top-up and legal timing

Megan —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our conversation, attaching a compact proposal for a quarterly bucket top-up that will cover the projected Q1 spike for ScaleRunner. High level: 

- Add 250k tokens/month reserved capacity (quarterly invoiced) for 6 months; effective 1/1/2026.
- Blended uplift discount: 12% off hosted API rate for the top-up volume vs on-demand usage.
- Option to co-term with your existing 2026 contract on 4/1/2026 (we can prorate the first invoice).

Requested items from your side so we can keep this on the 12/20 procurement cutoff:
1) Confirmation of billing cadence (quarterly invoice vs monthly split).
2) Legal preferred SOW recipient + expected review turnaround (is 3 business days realistic?).
3) PO process / billing contact and any vendor onboarding forms we should complete.

Attachments: ScaleRunner_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with uplift appendix), redwood_uplift_quote.xlsx (line-item pricing).

If that looks good, can we target a short approval call with procurement on Friday? I can loop in Lauren for the invoice and billing details.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134


From: Megan Li <megan.li@cloudwave.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ScaleRunner uplift — quarterly bucket top-up and legal timing

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear numbers. Quick Qs from procurement before we route to legal: 

- We typically prefer monthly invoices for cashflow; is it possible to receive monthly invoices that sum to the quarterly reserve? (we can still pay quarterly but need monthly line items).
- Does the uplift discount apply only to reserved tokens, or to all traffic once the reservoir is consumed?
- Our legal will need a single redlined SOW; can you confirm if the SOW you attached reflects the co-term option language?

Cc'ing procurement — procurement@cloudwave.com — to confirm PO window and vendor checklist. Our PO deadline for new vendor changes is 2025-12-20 EOD.

If you can confirm the two billing/discount points, I'll ask legal to prioritize and aim for a 48–72 hour turnaround.

Best,
Megan
Megan Li
Head of Cloud Ops | CloudWave
megan.li@cloudwave.com | +1 212-555-0198

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@cloudwave.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 10:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ScaleRunner uplift — quarterly bucket top-up and legal timing

Megan — looping in billing/finance detail. Quick answers and a couple of operational notes: 

- Monthly invoices: yes, we can emit monthly line-itemized invoices that roll up to the quarterly reserved total. We will show the reserved bucket quantity on each monthly invoice and the effective blended rate for that month.
- Discount mechanics: the 12% uplift discount applies to reserved tokens billed in the reserve line. If the reserved monthly bucket is exceeded, overage will be billed at the standard on-demand rate (no discount) unless you opt to convert overage into an additional reserved tranche — we can add an automated top-up clause if preferred.
- Co-term language: SOW_v3 includes an Appendix B (co-term option) — it allows co-terming with existing contracts effective on the requested date, with a prorated invoice in month of swap. If legal has edits, please send redlines and we'll pull together a final SOW.

I attached redwood_uplift_quote.xlsx — it includes two invoice scenarios: (A) quarterly invoiced but split monthly for your ledger, (B) monthly invoice equalization (higher per-month processing, slight admin fee). Scenario A is default and recommended.

Operational ask: procurement forms we typically see are W9 (we're US vendor) and a standard vendor onboarding PDF. If procurement sends the vendor checklist, Ben will complete the onboarding packet and return same day.

Happy to jump on a 20m call tomorrow to walk procurement through the invoice mock.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_uplift_quote.xlsx
From: Megan Li <megan.li@cloudwave.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.com
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2025 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ScaleRunner uplift — quarterly bucket top-up and legal timing

Great — this is helpful and close to what we need. Procurement confirms PO cutoff 2025-12-20; legal has requested that we prepare redlines by 2025-12-15 to meet that window. Action items from our side: 

- I'll send a short vendor checklist and our PO template by EOD.
- Legal asked that you add a one-paragraph data residency note in Appendix A (ScaleRunner is subject to a client data residency clause). If you can add that in SOW_v3 and resend, legal will attempt a 48-hour review.
- We'll accept monthly line-itemed invoices that total the quarterly reserved amount (Scenario A). Please ensure invoice fields match our PO template.

I can start the DocuSign flow once we receive the updated SOW (Appendix A note + any minor redlines) — please include the signers: Megan Li (CloudWave, VP), and the existing contract signee on our side (we'll confirm name in procurement).

I'll also flag procurement to expect Ben's completed onboarding packet. Thanks for the fast turnaround — looks like we can close inside the cutoff if we get the SOW update today/tomorrow.

Best,
Megan

Attachment: CloudWave_procurement_form.pdf (procurement template)
